title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.
content: The XRP Ledger Foundation has defended a recent emergency security patch designed to fix an unlimited XRP bug. Network operators previously raised concerns that the critical update was pushed onto them without sufficient warning or choice. However, the foundation pushed back against these claims, maintaining the necessity and proper handling of the urgent network security intervention.
content_ta: உடனடி XRP பக் பிரச்சினையை சரிசெய்ய வெளியிடப்பட்ட அவசர செக்யூரிட்டி பேட்ச் குறித்த விமர்சனங்களுக்கு XRP Ledger Foundation பதிலடி கொடுத்துள்ளது. இந்த அவசர அப்டேட் தங்களுக்கு வலுக்கட்டாயமாக திணிக்கப்பட்டதாக நெட்வொர்க் ஆபரேட்டர்கள் கவலை தெரிவித்திருந்தனர். இந்நிலையில், இந்த பாதுகாப்பு நடவடிக்கையின் அவசியத்தையும், அது சரியான முறையில் கையாளப்பட்டதாகவும் அமைப்பு தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

content_ta: Visa மற்றும் Tripadvisor உடன் இணைந்து Emirates NBD ஒரு புதிய AI travel assistant-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த conversational planner, Tripadvisor-ன் review-களைப் பயன்படுத்தி Visa cardholder-களுக்கான சலுகைகளை வழங்குகிறது. வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் வங்கி உள்நுழைவு (bank login) தேவையின்றி இந்த சேவையைப் பயன்படுத்தலாம்.

title: China’s Leadership Calls for National Blockchain Network in New Economic Guidelines
summary: On October 9, 2026, the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and the State Council issued the “Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces,” a policy document outlining 19 measures across areas including technological innovation, industrial upgrading, and institutional reform. Among the directives is... Read More
content: On October 9, 2026, China's leadership issued new economic guidelines calling for the development of a national Blockchain network. The policy document outlines measures across technological innovation and industrial upgrading, highlighting the country's continued focus on advancing digital infrastructure and emerging technologies.
content_ta: 2026 அக்டோபர் 9 அன்று, சீனாவின் தலைவர்கள் தேசிய அளவிலான Blockchain வலையமைப்பை உருவாக்குவதற்கான புதிய பொருளாதார வழிகாட்டுதல்களை வெளியிட்டுள்ளனர். தொழில்நுட்ப கண்டுபிடிப்புகள் மற்றும் தொழில்துறை மேம்பாடு தொடர்பான நடவடிக்கைகளை இந்த கொள்கை ஆவணம் கோடிட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Argentina’s Central Bank Rules Out Near-Term Crypto Integration into Banking Platforms
summary: Argentina’s monetary authority has closed the door on any near-term integration of cryptocurrencies into the formal banking and payments system, citing persistent economic fragility as the decisive constraint. Juan Curutchet, Superintendent of Financial and Foreign Exchange Institutions at the Banco Central de la República Argentina... Read More
content: Argentina’s Central Bank has ruled out the near-term integration of cryptocurrencies into the country's formal banking and payments system. The monetary authority cited ongoing economic fragility as the primary constraint preventing the adoption of crypto assets within traditional financial platforms at this time.
content_ta: அர்ஜென்டினாவின் Central Bank, நாட்டின் முறையான வங்கி மற்றும் கட்டண முறைமையில் cryptos-ஐ உடனடியாக இணைப்பதை நிராகரித்துள்ளது. தற்போதைய பொருளாதார பலவீனமே பாரம்பரிய நிதி தளங்களில் crypto assets-ஐ ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள முடியாததற்கு முக்கிய காரணம் என்று monetary authority தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.
content: A software bug capable of threatening XRP's 100 billion supply cap remained hidden for years. According to the XRP Ledger Foundation, the issue went undetected because normal operational parameters never triggered the specific conditions required to expose the flaw, ensuring the token's strict supply limit was never actually compromised.
content_ta: XRP-ன் 100 பில்லியன் சப்ளை வரம்புக்கு அச்சுறுத்தலாக இருந்த ஒரு சாஃப்ட்வேர் பக் பல ஆண்டுகளாக கண்டுபிடிக்கப்படாமல் இருந்தது. சாதாரண செயல்பாட்டுச் சூழல்களில் இந்த பக் தூண்டப்படவில்லை என்றும், அதனாலேயே இது இவ்வளவு காலம் கண்டறியப்படவில்லை என்றும் XRP Ledger Foundation தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
summary: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.
content: Ahead of the G20 meeting, the Financial Stability Board has highlighted growing concerns regarding cross-border stablecoin risks and artificial intelligence-related cybersecurity threats. The global watchdog urged policymakers worldwide to implement stronger regulatory safeguards and proactive measures to protect the international financial system from emerging digital vulnerabilities.
content_ta: G20 மாநாட்டிற்கு முன்னதாக, Financial Stability Board அமைப்பு எல்லை தாண்டிய stablecoin ஆபத்துகள் மற்றும் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு சார்ந்த சைபர் பாதுகாப்பு அச்சுறுத்தல்கள் குறித்து தனது கவலையை வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. வளர்ந்து வரும் டிஜிட்டல் சவால்களிலிருந்து சர்வதேச நிதி அமைப்பைப் பாதுகாக்க வலுவான பாதுகாப்பு நடவடிக்கைகளை எடுக்குமாறு கொள்கை வகுப்பாளர்களிடம் இந்த உலகளாவிய கண்காணிப்பாளர் வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளார்.

title: Solana sandwich bots took $29.7 million before costs, mostly targeting Pump.fun
summary:
Pump.fun's launch curve and PumpSwap accounted for 96% of detected attacks in the study's 11-month window.
The post Solana sandwich bots took $29.7 million before costs, mostly targeting Pump.fun appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Solana sandwich bots generated $29.7 million in revenue before costs over an 11-month period. Research reveals that the vast majority of these attacks, specifically 96%, targeted Pump.fun, including activities involving PumpSwap. These automated trading strategies exploited market mechanics on the platform, highlighting ongoing security and MEV challenges within the decentralized finance ecosystem.
content_ta: Solana-ல் செயல்படும் sandwich bots, 11 மாத காலத்தில் செலவுகளுக்கு முன்பு $29.7 மில்லியன் வருமானம் ஈட்டியுள்ளன. இந்தத் தாக்குதல்களில் 96% Pump.fun-ஐ இலக்காகக் கொண்டு நடைபெற்றதாக ஆய்வுகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன. PumpSwap தொடர்பான செயல்பாடுகளும் இதில் அடங்கும். இந்த தானியங்கி வர்த்தக முறைகள் இயங்குதளத்தின் சந்தை வழிமுறைகளைப் பயன்படுத்தி லாபம் ஈட்டியுள்ளன.

content: XRP recently saw a price rebound following a liquidation wave sampled by XRPL.to, which brought back exposure for Binance and Bybit. Interestingly, this recovery took place while spot trading turnover on Binance experienced a significant drop of nearly 80%.
content_ta: XRPL.to-ன் லிக்விடேஷன் அலைக்குப் பிறகு Binance மற்றும் Bybit-க்கான வெளிப்பாடு திரும்பியதால், XRP விலை மீண்டுள்ளது. சுவாரஸ்யமாக, Binance-ல் ஸ்பாட் வர்த்தக விற்றுமுதல் கிட்டத்தட்ட 80% சரிந்தபோது இந்த மீட்சி ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: From TOKEN2049 to Ecosystem Co-Building: HTX Advances Its Multifaceted Engagement Across the Global Crypto Industry
summary: Singapore, October 12, 2026 – From October 6 to 8, the global crypto industry turned its attention to Singapore for TOKEN2049, a major international industry event. Taking advantage of the gathering, HTX pursued a multifaceted approach encompassing global industry engagement, ecosystem development, and brand awareness. HTX Ventures exhibited at TOKEN2049, where its booth welcomed a steady stream of visitors. HTX DAO hosted “Future Night” and “HTX DAO Reunion,” bringing together industry perspectives and community voices. Meanwhile, a private industry dinner provided an opportunity for invited industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners to connect and exchange views.  From the public stage of a global summit to in-depth exchanges with ecosystem participants and face-to-face conversations with industry peers, HTX’s presence at TOKEN2049 reflected diverse efforts in industry networking, ecosystem development, and partnership building. Beyond providing opportunities for international industry engagement, these events reflected HTX’s ongoing efforts to strengthen industry connections and foster ecosystem collaboration.  Taking the Global Crypto Stage: Strong Visitor Interest at the HTX Ventures Booth As a major annual event for the global crypto industry, TOKEN2049 brings together project teams, investment firms, developers, crypto exchanges, and industry builders from around the world. It serves as an important platform for tracking industry trends, forging business connections, and exploring opportunities for global collaboration. From October 7-8, HTX Ventures, HTX’s global investment arm, exhibited at TOKEN2049 at the Sands Expo and Convention Center in Singapore, with its booth located at Level 5, PB5-47 and PB5-48. Throughout the event, the exhibition floor remained busy, drawing a steady stream of industry participants. The HTX Ventures booth welcomed numerous visitors, offering an engaging, interactive brand experience through brand displays, on-site community activities , and branded merchandise. These activities encouraged visitors to stop by and connect with the team, bringing the HTX brand into face-to-face interactions with members of the global crypto community.   Meanwhile, Justin Sun, Advisor to HTX, attended related events and delivered a speech before visiting the HTX Ventures booth to engage with the team and other industry participants, further strengthening HTX’s connections with the global crypto industry. For the crypto industry, the value of an international summit lies not only in raising brand awareness but also in building meaningful connections with industry participants. By combining booth displays, on-site activities, and industry engagement, HTX Ventures brought the brand closer to the global crypto community, creating more opportunities for connections across the investment ecosystem, project discussions, and potential partnerships. From steady visitor traffic at its booth to a diverse range of on-site activities, HTX Ventures maintained a strong presence at TOKEN2049, providing HTX with another valuable opportunity to strengthen its connections across the global crypto industry. From Industry Trends to Ecosystem Development: HTX DAO Advances Community Co-Building While the TOKEN2049 booth served as HTX’s brand showcase to the global crypto industry, the series of events hosted by HTX DAO took these conversations further, exploring broader topics such as industry trends, community building, and ecosystem development. On the evening of October 6, HTX DAO hosted the “Future Night” event in Singapore. Molly, an HTX DAO ambassador, shared the latest developments in ecosystem mechanisms, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem. Justin Sun, a core supporter of HTX DAO, delivered a video address sharing his perspectives on trends in the crypto industry and the future development of the digital economy. Sun noted that the crypto industry is deepening its ties with traditional finance, driving the continued digital transformation of global financial infrastructure. AI is changing how wealth is created, while crypto and digital finance are reshaping how wealth is held and transferred. He further noted that stablecoins could play a greater role in global payments and settlements, while the use of traditional assets such as bonds, funds and gold on-chain will continue to evolve. As AI agents become increasingly involved in economic activity, demand for digital identities, account infrastructure, and the ability to transact autonomously is also likely to grow. In his view, the long-term value of technology lies in its ability to deliver tangible productivity gains. The free flow of value in the digital world will be a key trend to watch over the next decade. On ecosystem development, Molly said HTX DAO is exploring potential token utility and ecosystem applications, alongside other initiatives aimed at supporting the development of its ecosystem. For community building, HTX DAO plans to establish regional community hubs in the fourth quarter, enabling members to organize events, exchange ideas, and contribute to the development of the community’s culture. Nearly 200 active volunteers are already contributing to these efforts on their own initiative. To strengthen its on-chain ecosystem, HTX DAO is engaging university developers from around the world through initiatives such as hackathons. Several projects are currently being explored or developed, including potential applications within the $HTX ecosystem.  Molly emphasized that ecosystem development requires a long-term commitment. HTX DAO will continue to strengthen its infrastructure, foster an active community, and drive the adoption of ecosystem applications. As an ecosystem participant, HTX continues to gather user feedback and explore improvements to its platform and user experience, with a view to better understanding and responding to evolving user needs.  From discussions on industry trends to practical initiatives in community development and the on-chain ecosystem, the Future Night event highlighted HTX DAO’s sustained commitment to long-term ecosystem development health  and provided a platform for global community members and industry contributors to connect and collaborate. III. From Online Communities to In-Person Gatherings: The HTX DAO Reunion Strengthens Ecosystem Connections Ecosystem growth depends not only on mechanisms and technology, but also on trust among community members and sustained collaboration among participants united by shared goals. From October 6 to 8, HTX DAO hosted the HTX DAO Reunion, bringing together industry representatives, ecosystem partners, and community members aboard a yacht for face-to-face discussions in an informal setting.  Unlike traditional conferences built around structured agendas and formal presentations, the event created a more informal setting for participants to exchange views on industry trends, community development, and potential collaborations, fostering a deeper mutual understanding. For a DAO ecosystem to develop sustainably, community means more than online discussions and on-chain governance. It also depends on meaningful personal connections, ongoing exchanges, and active participation. By creating more diverse opportunities for in-person engagement, HTX DAO is strengthening its ties with community members and partners, opening up new possibilities for community-driven development, ecosystem collaboration, and future partnerships. From themed discussions to open exchanges, and from online participation to in-person engagement, HTX DAO is exploring diverse approaches to community building and continually strengthening connections among ecosystem participants. VIP Industry Gathering: Strengthening Face-to-Face Engagement with Ecosystem and Industry Partners Alongside public engagement with the global industry, HTX also made strengthening relationships with industry peers and partners a priority during Singapore Week. During the week, HTX hosted a private industry dinner attended by invited industry representatives, ecosystem contributors, and partners.  Compared with large industry summits, private gatherings provide a more personal setting for direct conversations. These face-to-face interactions allow HTX to listen more closely to partners and exchange views on industry developments, market developments and potential future collaborations. As the crypto industry evolves, fostering industry relationships requires an understanding of ecosystem developments, effective communication, and the cultivation of long-term partnerships. Face-to-face engagement helps build mutual understanding, laying the groundwork for expanded collaboration across the sector. From industry discussions at the global summit to in-depth conversations in private settings, HTX is continuously strengthening its relationships with industry partners through engagement at multiple levels. Driving Long-Term Growth Through Global Engagement: HTX Expands Ecosystem Collaboration Throughout TOKEN2049 Singapore Week, HTX engaged across multiple fronts, including global industry dialogue, ecosystem development, brand visibility, and industry networking. HTX Ventures leveraged the international summit to expand its industry network and boost brand engagement through booth activities and in-person interactions. HTX DAO explored industry trends, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem, strengthening connections with community members and developers. Meanwhile, a series of in-person events and private industry gatherings provided further opportunities for HTX to engage with industry peers, ecosystem contributors, and partners.    While each initiative served a different purpose, they all contributed to the same overarching goal of building broader, deeper, and more enduring industry relationships as the global crypto industry continues to evolve. For participants in the crypto industry, brand influence stems not only from market visibility but also from sustained engagement in industry development, responsiveness to user needs, and efforts to foster collaboration among communities, projects, and partners. Looking ahead, HTX intends to continue its engagement with industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners, while exploring opportunities for ecosystem collaboration and platform improvements, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. By strengthening connections among global communities, developers, projects, and industry partners, HTX aims to explore new opportunities for the development of digital finance and blockchain ecosystems. From the global industry stage to the front lines of ecosystem development, HTX will continue to bring industry participants together through open collaboration and drive ecosystem growth through long-term commitment.   Media inquiries, please contact glo-media@htx-inc.com.
content: During TOKEN2049 in Singapore, HTX actively expanded its global crypto industry engagement through multiple fronts. HTX Ventures showcased its brand at the exhibition booth, while HTX DAO hosted community events like "Future Night" and the "HTX DAO Reunion" to discuss trends and ecosystem development. Additionally, HTX hosted a private industry dinner to strengthen partnerships, reflecting its ongoing commitment to collaboration and long-term growth across the blockchain sector.
content_ta: சிங்கப்பூரில் நடைபெற்ற TOKEN2049 மாநாட்டின் போது, HTX தனது உலகளாவிய கிரிப்டோ துறை ஈடுதலை பல வழிகளில் விரிவுபடுத்தியது. HTX Ventures தனது கண்காட்சிக் அரங்கில் தன் பிராண்டை வெளிப்படுத்தியது, அதேசமயம் HTX DAO போக்குகள் மற்றும் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பு வளர்ச்சியைப் பற்றி விவாதிக்க "Future Night" மற்றும் "HTX DAO Reunion" போன்ற சமூக நிகழ்வுகளை நடத்தியது. கூடுதலாக, கூட்டாண்மைகளை வலுப்படுத்த HTX ஒரு தனிப்பட்ட துறை விருந்துக்கு ஏற்பாடு செய்தது, இது பிளாக்செயின் துறையில் ஒத்துழைப்பு மற்றும் நீண்டகால வளர்ச்சிக்கான அதன் தொடர்ச்சியான உறுதிப்பாட்டை பிரதிபலிக்கிறது.

title: Coinbase AI Agent Cuts Fraud by 30% in Onramp Experiment
summary: The adapted model caught a larger share of fraudulent transaction value, a measure that can matter more than simply counting detected cases.
content: Coinbase recently utilized an AI agent in an onramp experiment, which successfully reduced fraud by 30%. According to the company, the adapted model identified a larger share of fraudulent transaction value. This metric is often considered more significant than merely counting the total number of detected cases, highlighting the effectiveness of advanced artificial intelligence in securing cryptocurrency onboarding processes.

title: Syfe Launches Income+ Max, Delivering Target Payouts up to 10% p.a. to Help Investors Turn Volatility into Income
summary:
Syfe, the Singapore-headquartered digital wealth platform managing over S$20 billion in assets across Asia-Pacific, today announced the launch of Income+ Max in collaboration with key Active ETF partner J.P. Morgan Asset Management and two other leading ETF managers. The multi-asset strategy addresses the biggest challenges for investors today: record-low dividend yields and extreme equity concentration, compounded by intense volatility. 
Unmanaged portfolio drift remains a hidden risk for retail investors, as evidenced by the 2022-era 60/40 allocation that crept to a stock-heavy 73/27 split by August 2026. Syfe’s multi-asset income strategy resolves this concentration risk by combining defensive multi-asset exposure with options on equities and gold – monetising short-term volatility to generate targeted yields of 8% to 10% per annum*. 
Diversified by design: Five income engines 
Income+ Max allocates across three core asset sleeves while drawing from five distinct income drivers. Each sleeve earns income a different way: coupons from the bond allocation, dividends from quality large caps, and option premiums written on the tech, small-cap and gold exposures, so no single source carries the payout.
Equities (55%): Focuses on high-quality companies with strong fundamentals and lower volatility than the broader market.
Fixed Income (35%): Maintains a short-to-medium duration profile to limit interest rate sensitivity, with credit and emerging market selection underwritten by J.P. Morgan Asset Management.
Gold (10%): Provides a structural diversifier and store of value when stocks and bonds move in tandem.
How volatility becomes income
The strategy sells call options on a portion of its equity and gold holdings and collects the premium as income. Option premiums rise when markets are uncertain, so the more volatile the environment, the more income the strategy can harvest. That premium, combined with dividends and bond coupons, is what funds the targeted 8% to 10% payout. 
Income+ Max removes the administrative complexity and cost of running a global income portfolio, with automated rebalancing and reinvesting.
The launch expands Syfe’s cash-income range, complementing the more conservative, bond-focused Income+ Preserve and Income+ Enhance portfolios.
Ritesh Ganeriwal, MD, Group Head of Investment & Advisory at Syfe, said: “Everyone’s talking about yields coming back, and bonds do pay again. But stock dividends are sitting near record lows, and chasing them means piling into the same few names as everyone else. Income+ Max goes about it differently. It earns income from market volatility itself: we write options on quality equities and gold, collect the premium and pay it out. Gold helps cushion the portfolio when markets turn, and fees are in line with passive index funds. With this launch, investors can now get cash management, bond income, multi-asset and options-based income all on Syfe.”
Ayaz Ebrahim, CEO of Singapore, South East Asia and India at J.P. Morgan Asset Management, said:  “J.P. Morgan Asset Management is pleased to be a key Active ETF provider for the Syfe Income+ Max portfolio. This collaboration reflects the growing role of active ETFs in investors’ portfolios, and we look forward to leveraging our active ETF expertise to help investors pursue resilient income outcomes with transparency and accessibility.”
Income+ Max is currently being rolled out to users on the Syfe platform. To find out more: https://www.syfe.com/income-plus
* Income+ portfolios target a monthly payout range based on current market conditions. Target monthly payout is not guaranteed, and is subject to market movements. A positive payout or distribution yield does not imply a positive return. Source: Syfe, fund factsheets, as of October 2026.
NoYesWealth Management12 Oct, 2026
content: Digital wealth platform Syfe has launched Income+ Max, a new multi-asset strategy designed to help investors turn market volatility into targeted annual payouts of up to 10 percent. Developed in collaboration with J.P. Morgan Asset Management and other ETF managers, the strategy combines equities, fixed income, and gold with option premiums to address low dividend yields and portfolio concentration risks for retail investors.

title: WEX and Mastercard Partner to Launch Asia-Pacific's First Unified Fleet Payments Network
summary:
WEX and Mastercard today announced a strategic partnership set to simplify fleet management operations and modernise fleet payments across Asia-Pacific. The strategic partnership marks a first-of-its-kind initiative in the region that will drive the next-generation payments infrastructure by bringing together universal fuel, vehicle fleet maintenance, tolling, parking and more, in a single payment experience. The program is projected to process billions of dollars in annual transactions as it expands across key regional markets.
This collaboration combines Mastercard's global network, which processed 175 billion transactions in 2025, with WEX's standing as one of the world's leading issuers of virtual cards for travel payments and 40+ years of fleet management expertise. For fleet managers, fuel, maintenance, tolling and parking costs often sit across separate payment systems, making it difficult to see the full picture and creating extra work to reconcile bills. The partnership is designed to change that, helping drive daily efficiency and growth. 
Driving efficiency in the world’s fastest-growing fleet market
This strategic partnership arrives as Asia-Pacific emerges as the fastest-growing fleet management region globally. Fleet-card transaction volumes in the region are estimated at approximately US$310 billion (A$435 billion) in 2025, accounting for 31% of global volumes, and are projected to grow at 14.3% a year through 2030.
Despite this rapid expansion, fleet management operators across the region continue to face friction driven by fragmented data and siloed, legacy payment systems. 

“In 2026, the competitive advantage for fleets is found in simplicity. WEX is already a global pioneer in travel and corporate virtual payments; by joining forces with Mastercard in this new capacity, we are bringing that same engine of innovation to the APAC mobility sector,” said Matt Arthur, vice president and general manager, APAC Mobility at WEX. 
“For decades, fleets have used one card for fuel and a patchwork of systems for everything else, leaving fleet managers to stitch it all together. This strategic partnership creates a smarter infrastructure that allows our customers to manage the transition to hybrid fleets and navigate economic volatility with total visibility over their operations,” Arthur added. 
Pillars of the strategic partnership
The strategic partnership focuses on three core pillars designed to future-proof Asia-Pacific businesses:
·      Unified payments and data infrastructure: An integrated experience that replaces fragmented legacy systems, and unifies traditional fleet costs like fuel, maintenance, tolling, and parking with broader business expenses into one cohesive view.
Actionable intelligence & control: Eliminating administrative friction with real-time, configurable spend controls and automated insights embedded directly into business workflows, as well as enabling reporting controls on line-item-level data like fuel types and litres.
Future-ready mixed-energy fleet: Delivering integrated solutions that allow businesses to manage traditional fuel, hybrid, and electric vehicles under a single account with one consolidated invoice.
“Transportation is a critical growth engine. It sits at the center of how people and goods move, especially in a diverse region like Asia-Pacific,” said Anouska Ladds, Executive Vice President, Commercial and New Payment Flows, Asia Pacific, Mastercard.
“Our collaboration with WEX is an essential example of how we scale with impact. By combining our global network with their deep industry expertise, we’re helping businesses move faster, operate smarter and prepare for what’s next. Together, we’re setting a new standard for a future-ready mobility ecosystem,” Ladds added.
This collaboration expands on a decades-long relationship with Mastercard, building on WEX’s position as #1 globally in volume of virtual card travel payments - powering 50% of all virtual card payments in the travel sector.
In 2025, WEX processed more than US$237 billion in total volume across its global commerce platform, reflecting the extensive scale and trust built in part through its long-standing co-innovation with Mastercard.

title: Mastercard Expands Its European Tech Hub in Dublin, Reinforcing Its Commitment to Europe's Digital Future
summary:
Mastercard is expanding its European Tech Hub in Dublin with the opening of a second office building at its Leopardstown campus — an innovation engine for the technologies that will power the next era of payments and commerce.
The new building, Two South County, was officially opened today by Taoiseach Micheál Martin alongside Mastercard senior executives Michael Miebach, CEO; Kelly Devine, President, Mastercard Europe; Ed McLaughlin, President and Chief Technology Officer and Ken Moore, Chief Innovation Officer.
The expansion marks a new chapter in Mastercard’s nearly 20-year presence in Ireland and in its work to build the future of payments in Europe, for Europe. Since establishing operations in Ireland in 2008 with just 36 employees, Mastercard has grown its Dublin workforce to more than 2,000 talented technologists from across the world.
Working as part of Mastercard’s global technology network, the Dublin teams have helped develop key technologies behind everyday payments made by millions of people around the world — including the tokenisation platform that powers wallet payments. With Mastercard’s continued investment in Dublin, supported by the Irish government and IDA Ireland, the teams are now playing a leading role in shaping the future of payments, from agentic commerce and quantum-resilient payments to digital security and network resilience.
Taoiseach Micheál Martin said: "The opening of Mastercard’s new office is a strong endorsement of Ireland’s reputation as a leading location for innovation, technology and digital transformation. Mastercard has played a key role in shaping the future of payments and financial technology globally, and its continued expansion in Ireland highlights the strength of our talented workforce, pro-business environment and vibrant technology ecosystem. I warmly welcome this investment and look forward to seeing Mastercard continue to innovate and grow from its Irish base in the years ahead."
"Europe has always been a driving force in payments innovation and Dublin sits at the heart of that story for Mastercard," said Ed McLaughlin, President and Chief Technology Officer at Mastercard. "From AI and cybersecurity to next-generation payments infrastructure that brings greater resilience and speed to commerce, the work happening here is helping build the future. This expansion of our European Tech Hub reflects the growth of our teams in Dublin, our confidence in Ireland's talent, and our ambitions for the years ahead."
The Dublin expansion forms part of a wider programme of investment in Europe’s digital payments future. Today, Mastercard also announced that it is:
Delivering on its commitment to expand and localise critical payments operations in Europe and has now started to process domestic transactions in France, Germany and Spain through its new European infrastructure. More countries will follow from next year, with the aim of bringing all components of local transactions into Europe by 2030.
 


Developing offline payment capabilities to enhance Europe’s payments resilience. All new Mastercard European credit and debit cards issued from next year – and all new payment terminals powered by its acquiring partners at essential retailers such as supermarkets and petrol stations – will have to support offline payments. This means people will be able to keep buying essentials during internet outages and power cuts.
Investing to keep the primary copy of intra-EEA transaction data in Europe.
Strengthening its European governance, recruiting a third independent European board member, who will serve as Chair of the Mastercard Europe Board of Directors.
"The technology developed in Dublin is helping solve real challenges for people and businesses across Europe and around the world,” said Kelly Devine, President, Mastercard Europe. “This expansion underlines our focus on turning innovation into secure, resilient payment experiences that customers can rely on.”
Michael Lohan, CEO of IDA Ireland said: “Mastercard’s decision to expand its European Tech Hub in Dublin with a new office is a strong vote of confidence in Ireland and in the talent and innovation that have supported the company’s growth here for almost 20 years. This latest investment positions the Dublin team to play an even greater role in developing exciting new technologies that will shape the future of payments, while further strengthening Ireland’s thriving financial services sector. IDA Ireland looks forward to continuing to support Mastercard as it enters this next phase of growth.”

summary: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.
content: A global financial watchdog has urged authorities to improve cross-border information sharing and planning to handle potential stablecoin crises. The warning highlights that stablecoins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands strike another, significantly complicating international crisis responses.
content_ta: உலகளாவிய நிதி கண்காணிப்பாளர் அமைப்பு, சாத்தியமான stablecoin நெருக்கடிகளைக் கையாள எல்லை தாண்டிய தகவல் பகிர்வு மற்றும் திட்டமிடலை மேம்படுத்துமாறு அதிகாரிகளை வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளது. பல நிறுவனங்களால் கூட்டாக வெளியிடப்படும் coins ஒரு அதிகார வரம்பில் இருப்புகளைப் பூட்டி வைக்கலாம், அதே நேரத்தில் மீட்புக் கோரிக்கைகள் மற்றொரு அதிகார வரம்பைத் தாக்கும், இது சர்வதேச நெருக்கடி பதிலளிப்பு நடவடிக்கைகளை கணிசமாக சிக்கலாக்கும் என்று இந்த எச்சரிக்கை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

title: MEXC Brings AI, TradFi and the Future of Trading to Life at TOKEN2049 Singapore
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, October 12, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, concluded its TOKEN2049 Singapore presence with a series of interactive experiences and industry discussions spanning TradFi access, AI-powered trading and the future evolution of global trading platforms. MEXC’s presence centered on three key areas: the MEXC Stage and a panel featuring MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade and Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi, hands-on AI experiences including the MEXC AI Trading Challenge powered by MEXC CLI and the AI Bond Test, and The NEXT Newspaper, an interactive experience that brought insights around TradFi, AI and the future of investing into a more engaging community format. Thousands of participants joined MEXC’s on-site activities during the event, reflecting strong interest in both AI-enabled trading and broader access to traditional financial markets. Across the booth and the MEXC Stage, these themes came together around a broader question: how trading platforms can become more connected, accessible and intelligent as crypto and traditional finance continue to converge. Exploring AI Through Hands-On Experiences AI was one of the most visible themes across the MEXC booth. Through the MEXC AI Trading Challenge, visitors experienced how natural-language instructions, AI agents and MEXC CLI can work together to move trading ideas more directly from analysis to action. The experience demonstrated how users can express what they want to do in everyday language, while AI agents supported by MEXC CLI connect those intentions with MEXC trading capabilities. Alongside the trading experience, the AI Bond Test offered a more playful way for visitors to explore their relationship with AI, including how they use, trust and interact with AI in everyday decision-making. Together, the two activities reflected growing interest not only in AI as an information or research tool, but also in how it could become a more natural part of the broader trading experience.   Bringing TradFi Insights Into the Community Traditional financial markets were another major area of interest at TOKEN2049. Through The NEXT Newspaper, MEXC transformed research insights around AI, trading and global markets into an interactive experience. Visitors could personalize their own newspaper with their photo and predictions about the future of investing, creating a bridge between research, market trends and community participation. The activation reflected a broader shift in retail investing as users increasingly look beyond crypto toward stocks, commodities and other traditional financial assets, while expecting to access these opportunities through more seamless digital platforms.   From Crypto-TradFi Convergence to Platform Collaboration These themes also extended to the MEXC Stage, where MEXC CEO Vugar Usi Zade joined Payward Co-CEO Arjun Sethi. The panel explored how crypto and traditional finance are moving toward a more connected, always-on financial environment, and how retail demand could help drive the evolution toward platforms that provide access across multiple asset classes. Arjun highlighted the infrastructure needed to support this evolution, noting that the promise of 24/7 markets ultimately depends on connecting assets and collateral more effectively. Collaboration was another key theme. Arjun pointed to partnerships as an important part of reaching more global users, specifically referencing MEXC as an example of a platform that could help partners succeed in their respective core markets. Vugar similarly highlighted how platforms can build on different strengths across infrastructure, market access and retail distribution rather than approaching every opportunity purely through competition. AI also featured in the discussion as part of the longer-term evolution of trading. Vugar noted that AI can help retail users process large amounts of information more efficiently and convert insights into action, while increasingly agentic tools could further change how users interact with financial platforms. From hands-on AI experiences to TradFi engagement and conversations about the future of market infrastructure, MEXC’s TOKEN2049 presence reflected a broader direction for trading: more connected markets, broader access and increasingly intelligent ways for users to participate.   For more highlights from TOKEN2049 Singapore, watch the event recap video.   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway. With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. title: Tereina Brings Forward the Future of Financial Services, Starting with Embedded, Digital and Agentic Payments
summary:
Tereina today launched on a core belief: the future of financial services is embedded, digital and agentic. Its technology lets finance teams optimize and execute payments on their own or with support from their AI agents, settling seamlessly across traditional and digital-currency rails, embedded directly into the business applications enterprises already run.
Tereina sees this as the first step toward a broader shift in financial services: simplifying and speeding up the payments businesses already run today, while building toward a future where agents can advise on and execute payments directly, with money and information moving together, seamlessly. At the same time, stablecoins are becoming a practical rail for businesses: instant, always-on, and borderless. Tereina is built as one system that settles every transaction on whichever currency — fiat or stablecoin — best fits, extending that same choice to how suppliers and customers pay and get paid, with more capabilities on the way.
“Winncom has dealt with complicated payments and supplier processes throughout our company’s history. Tereina brings us the future of payments, simplifying those processes and making our money move exactly when we need it, smarter than ever.”
— Vladimir Fedoroff, CFO, Winncom Technologies

Tereina’s value proposition comes down to zero friction, lower cost, and full control. Integration requires no code or manual work and is available instantly. Tereina aims to drop total cost of ownership by 25% against what businesses pay today on average. And zero-touch routing closes the manual exception points fraud relies on, while payment timing and approvals stay in the customer’s hands, with rail preference extending to their suppliers and customers, too. SAP customers can access this today as SAP Pay, covering supplier, incoming, employee, and intracompany payments, with the same capabilities extending to other business applications through API integration.
That same simplicity makes digital currency — stablecoins today, tokenized deposits soon — accessible to finance teams without new systems, headcount, or expertise: what used to take days to clear and half a day to reconcile now settles and posts instantly, freeing working capital and putting idle cash to work.
“Total B2B payment volume is expected to exceed $200 trillion by 2030, fueling even faster global commerce. Businesses deserve the best of what’s possible today and what’s coming next. We’re proud to bring our customers best-in-class financial services alongside our technology, banking, issuing, and fintech partners — starting with the future of payments: embedded, digital, and agentic. Tereina is making that future available now.”
— Cedric Bru, CEO, Tereina

Led by CEO Cedric Bru, the platform allows finance teams to optimize and execute payments seamlessly across traditional and digital currency rails like stablecoins. Integrated directly into business apps like SAP, Tereina aims to reduce total cost of ownership, eliminate manual processes, and offer zero-friction B2B transactions for enterprises globally.

title: Agentiq Raises $4 Million to Launch Fan-to-Athlete Investment Platform
summary:
Agentiq Sports, Inc. ("Agentiq"), the fintech platform allowing fans to indirectly invest in professional athletes' careers, today announced $4 million in funding. The round was led by defy.vc, the Silicon Valley venture firm behind multiple breakout consumer and fintech companies, and by a group led by the owner of two major European football clubs. Agentiq believes that the funding will accelerate its platform launch and allow Agentiq to scale its team and pipeline.
"For too long, being a sports fan has meant paying an entertainment tax," said Zach Kurtz, Co-Founder and CEO of Agentiq. "Betting apps, fantasy platforms, prediction markets: they all monetize your passion and give you nothing durable in return. We are building the opposite. The Agentiq platform gives fans a way to back the athletes they believe in and share in their journey. A real stake and a real connection."
Traditionally, private athlete-equity funds have operated behind closed doors, signing more than 2,000 athletes to long-term income-share agreements with limited transparency. Athletes early in their careers have had few options for accessing capital beyond traditional debt or these opaque private arrangements.
On Agentiq's platform, each athlete offering is conducted publicly through a designated series of a Delaware Series LLC. Under a Brand Advisory Agreement, the applicable Series provides the athlete with non-debt capital and brand advisory services in exchange for a defined percentage of covered future on-field Brand Income. By opening these athlete-linked offerings to everyday investors, the Agentiq platform aims to democratize investment opportunities historically dominated by private equity and other institutional counterparties. Agentiq believes its model gives athletes access to more flexible and transparent deal structures, allows them to de-risk their careers and invest in themselves, and creates a direct connection with the fans who believe in them.
Agentiq's initial athlete offerings are headlined by Justin Martinez, the 25-year-old flamethrowing closer of the Diamondbacks, and Esmerlyn Valdez, the 22-year-old Pittsburgh Pirates outfielder who has emerged as one of the most electric rookies in Major League Baseball. Through July 19, 2026, Valdez had already hit 12 home runs in 31 games. Valdez is a prime example of the type of athlete the Agentiq platform was designed for: a dynamic talent at the beginning of what could be a standout career.
In addition to Martinez and Valdez, Agentiq has signed Cardinals starting pitcher Hunter Dobbins, Ronny Cruz, Carlos Virahonda and hopes to have more than 50 athletes on the roster within the next 12 months. The company maintains a pipeline of more than 200 professional athletes across MLB, the NFL, and other major leagues.
Agentiq sits at the intersection of three compounding trends:
Fan engagement with financial products has gone mainstream. More than 40 million Americans actively use platforms like Robinhood, while Polymarket and Kalshi have normalized the idea of financial participation in real-world outcomes. Consumer demand for new, accessible ways to engage with sports has never been stronger.
The sports economy is at an all-time high. League valuations, NIL deal volume, betting handle, and prediction-market activity have all compounded for a decade. Private athlete-equity funds close 500+ deals per year, demonstrating strong demand for athlete-linked financial products.
Athletes are taking control of their economic futures. NIL reshaped college sports, and professional athletes increasingly view themselves as brands and businesses, not just players. Yet their options for non-debt capital remain limited to opaque private funds with rigid terms. Agentiq believes its model provides athletes with a transparent, fan-facing alternative.
"Fans have always wanted to feel closer to the athletes and teams they love, but there hasn't been an easy, accessible way to be part of an athlete's journey beyond simply watching and cheering them on," said Medha Agarwal, General Partner at defy.vc. "Agentiq is changing that by giving fans a new way to support athletes and share in their success over the long term. We believe Zach and Reuben have the vision and experience to build something truly new for the next generation of sports fans."
For decades, the sports industry has treated fans as a revenue source, not a stakeholder. Sports betting extracted a record $17 billion in revenue from American consumers in 2025 alone1, with sportsbooks keeping roughly 10 cents of every dollar wagered. Research shows that 95 to 97 percent of sports bettors lose money over any meaningful time period.2 Prediction markets are no better. On one of the main platforms, ordinary users have lost more than half a billion dollars since the platform launched.3 The common thread: fans pay to participate in short-duration products tied to discrete outcomes, while the house wins, and nothing of lasting value is created for most consumers.
Agentiq gives eligible fans the opportunity to indirectly invest in certain athletes' on-field careers. These SEC-qualified offerings result in ownership of securities that are freely tradable under U.S. federal securities law.
Founded by Zach Kurtz (CEO, fintech veteran, former D1 baseball player at University of Richmond, owner of a sporting products company used by 50+ pro players) and Reuben Abraham (CTO, employee 10 at Pave, former NerdWallet, UPenn Jerome Fisher M&T and Wharton '17, UAE Cricket National Team). The team includes former professional players and agents, as well as former data scientists with experience working in MLB front offices. Agentiq is headquartered in New York. For more information, visit agentiqsports.com.

title: The UK’s Digital Money Map: Regions Reveal Different Routes to Financial Progress
summary:
New analysis from Lloyds Banking Group finds that financial empowerment - having the confidence, capability and control to make informed financial decisions - has no single UK postcode. Across the country, people are using digital tools and AI for different priorities, from budgeting and debt reduction to investing, saving and planning ahead, with distinct regional patterns emerging. 
Nationally, digital tools are now a routine part of money management: across the UK nearly nine in ten (88%) users manage or track their finances digitally at least once a week. AI is also delivering reported savings, with adopters nationally estimating an average saving of £399 after following AI-powered financial recommendations. The regional picture shows how these tools are being put to work in different ways across the country. 
A different financial story in every part of the UK 
London emerges as the UK’s AI finance capital. More than three-quarters of respondents (76%) have used AI for personal finance in the past year, while 49% use it daily or weekly. Among AI users, 48% have used it for investment research. Londoners also report average savings of £562 after following AI recommendations, 41% higher (+£163) than the UK average*. However, just 75% of Londoners who use digital tools feel confident doing so - the lowest of any UK region, appearing to indicate that confidence does not arise from digital tool use alone. 
Elsewhere, digital finance serves different needs. Yorkshire and the Humber leads for budgeting and tracking spending (44%); the East Midlands for debt reduction (24%); and Wales for managing or growing investments, pensions or ISAs (23%). Scotland leads for digital cashback and credit monitoring: 39% of users use rewards apps and 38% regularly monitor their credit score, both UK highs. 
Where digital tools are delivering results 
The regional picture spans day-to-day control and longer-term ambition. In the South West, 48% of digital tool users say the tools help them feel more in control, the UK’s highest share. In the West Midlands, above-average AI use sits alongside the UK’s strongest concern about bias in AI recommendations (30%), underscoring the need for transparency and trust. 
Northern Ireland records some of the UK’s strongest reported practical outcomes among active digital tool users. Almost half (48%) say digital tools help them manage money more quickly and easily, while a third (30%) say the tools have helped them set and achieve financial goals, 12 percentage points above the UK average. Respondents also report above-average priorities around education, entrepreneurship and important life events.** 
In the North West, AI serves both immediate and future needs: 31% of AI users have used it for debt management and 44% for future financial planning. In the North East, 57% cite day-to-day expenses as a top priority, the UK’s highest share. 
Wales combines the UK’s highest reported financial engagement (87%) and knowledge (88%) with a strong long-term focus. Nearly a quarter of digital tool users (23%) say the tools have helped them manage or grow investments, pensions or ISAs, the highest share of any nation or region. 

"Financial empowerment doesn’t look the same for everyone or in every region. And place can tell us a lot about the context in which financial choices are made.  
Managing your money online should feel underpinned by tools that can adapt to the life in front of them. The opportunity is to give people useful choices and tools, the confidence to act on them, and control over the financial lives people want to lead. To me, that is true financial empowerment."
Jas SinghCEO, Consumer at Lloyds Banking Group
The findings come from Money mapped, the second in a new Spotlight series from Lloyds Banking Group's Consumer Digital Index, following Generation gains, which looked at financial empowerment across different ages and life stages. Money mapped explores how financial empowerment varies across the UK's nations and regions.

title: Numou and Comera Financial Holding Partner to Expand Financing and Payment Solutions for UAE SMEs
summary:
Numou, a subsidiary of ADGM, and Comera Financial Holding (CFH), part of Abu Dhabi’s Royal Group, have signed a partnership agreement to expand access to financing and payment solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) across the UAE.
The partnership will bring Comera Financial Holding’s financial products and services to Numou’s digital marketplace, giving SMEs access to more options for financing, business account opening and digital payments.
The collaboration draws on CFH’s broader financial services portfolio, which includes business lending through Comera Finance, digital payments and merchant solutions through Comera Pay, and supply chain finance through Comera Money.
The agreement was signed at ADGM, Abu Dhabi’s international financial centre, in the presence of H.E. Badr Al Olama, Director General of the Abu Dhabi Investment Office & Chairman of Numou. It was signed by Mohamed Al Binali, General Manager of Numou, and Akhtar Saeed Hashmi, Managing Director and Group CEO of Comera Financial Holding.
Through the partnership, SMEs will be able to access working capital and supply chain financing to purchase inventory, pay suppliers and bridge the gap between delivering goods or services and receiving payment. Business account opening and digital payment solutions will also help businesses manage their everyday financial needs.
By combining Numou’s marketplace with CFH’s financing and payments capabilities, the partnership aims to help SMEs access the financial support they need at different stages of their business growth.
“SMEs need financial solutions that support the way they do business, from purchasing stock and paying suppliers to managing payments and funding growth. This partnership expands the options available through Numou, making it easier for UAE businesses to access the services they need through one platform,” said Mohamed Al Binali, General Manager, Numou.
“SME growth depends on access to capital and the ability to put it to work. At Comera Financial Holding, we are bringing financing and payments together to support that journey—from securing an order to receiving payment. Our partnership with Numou extends this approach to more businesses across the UAE, helping them respond to opportunities with greater confidence and build for the long term,” said Akhtar Saeed Hashmi, Managing Director & Group CEO, Comera Financial Holding.

title: Navan Selected by Investec to Modernize Global Travel Program

Investec needed a solution to increase platform adoption and help employees travel more cost-efficiently.

Higher adoption by providing access to Navan's inventory, which includes more than 600 airlines, over 2 million lodging properties, and major rail and rental-car providers.

Cost savings through increased adoption, access to expanded inventory, and improved policy compliance.

title: State of TRON Q3 2026 Report Highlights $2.21 Trillion in Stablecoin Settlement Amid Network Activity Growth
summary: Geneva, Switzerland, October 12, 2026 — TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), today highlighted key findings from its State of TRON Q3 2026 ecosystem report. The report examines network activity, stablecoin settlement, liquidity, tokenomics, developer activity, decentralization, and protocol governance during the third quarter of 2026.   TRON surpassed $30 trillion in cumulative transaction volume in Q3 2026, marking another milestone for a network used as infrastructure for stablecoin settlement and digital-asset transfers. At the same time, stablecoin supply and total value locked continued to expand, while the network’s active-address base grew and transaction activity remained broadly steady.   Key Insights In Q3, TRON surpassed $30 trillion in cumulative transaction volume. Stablecoin settlement reached $2.21 trillion in the Q3 reporting period, with average daily volume rising 3.9% from Q2 to $24.05 billion. Canary Capital launched the Canary Staked TRX ETF (TRXS) on September 9, 2026. TRXS gives investors exposure to the spot price of TRX—the native utility and governance token of the TRON blockchain network—alongside passive net staking rewards reflected directly in the fund’s daily net asset value. TRON DAO’s team rang the Cboe Closing Bell in Chicago on September 29 to celebrate its launch. TRON expanded its ecosystem collaborations in Q3 2026, adding institutional custody and staking, new trading venues, and digital dollar products through Anchorage Digital, Bitnomial, Backpack, Ethena, and Ducat. Payment, wallet, cross-chain, and developer integrations also broadened access and strengthened the infrastructure for payment, treasury, and DeFi applications.  Stablecoin supply and Total Value Locked continued to expand. USDT and USDD supply reached $93.88 billion, up 5.5% from Q2, while TVL including staking hit $28.21 billion and TVL excluding staking (DeFi TVL) hit $13.05 billion The active-address base widened while transaction frequency held steady. Average rolling monthly active addresses increased 9.8% to 18 million.  Network fee generation moderated. Fees totaled $701.4 million during Q3, averaging $7.62 million per day, down 4.0% from Q2. The average daily transaction fee fell from $0.668 to $0.643.    TRON’s ecosystem continued to broaden in Q3, with new integrations spanning institutional services, trading, stablecoins, payments, wallets, and developer infrastructure. Anchorage Digital added TRX staking and TRC-20 custody, while Bitnomial and Backpack expanded access to TRX markets. Ethena brought USDe and sUSDe to TRON, and Ducat connected its Bitcoin-backed financial infrastructure to the network’s stablecoin ecosystem.   The quarter also brought new capabilities for users and developers. MoonPay introduced gasless transactions through Trust Wallet, removing the need to hold TRX for network fees, while Bitcoin.com Wallet added native support for TRX and USDT-TRC20. MetaMask connectivity expanded across B.AI, SUN.io, JustLend DAO, and BitTorrent, while Fireblocks Flow added support for payments from TRON wallets. Eco and STON.fi expanded cross-chain stablecoin connectivity, and KiiChain linked TRON assets with its 24/7 foreign-exchange and payment infrastructure. For developers, Privy expanded wallet, transaction, and policy-management capabilities, while OpenZeppelin brought its smart contract libraries and security tooling to the network. Together, these integrations strengthened the infrastructure available for payments, treasury management, and DeFi applications on TRON.   TRON’s third-quarter developments underscore continued growth in stablecoin settlement, liquidity, network activity, and ecosystem infrastructure, reflecting sustained demand for its financial infrastructure. With these trends strengthening, TRON enters Q4 with an increasingly established role in global stablecoin settlement and digital asset activity.   Read the full report from TRON here.   About TRON DAO TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps.   Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of October 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 408 million in total user accounts, more than 15 billion in total transactions, and over $28 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.”   TRONNetwork | TRONDAO | X | YouTube | Telegram | Discord | Reddit | GitHub | Medium | Forum Media Contact Yeweon Park press@tron.network
content: TRON DAO released its State of TRON Q3 2026 report, highlighting $2.21 trillion in stablecoin settlements and exceeding $30 trillion in cumulative transaction volume. The quarter saw significant expansion in stablecoin supply, total value locked, and active addresses. Additionally, TRON broadened its ecosystem through new institutional, trading, and developer integrations, including the launch of the Canary Staked TRX ETF.
content_ta: TRON DAO நிறுவனம் தனது Q3 2026 க்கான அறிக்கையை வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. இதில் $2.21 டிரில்லியன் அளவிலான ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் பரிவர்த்தனைகள் நடந்துள்ளதாகக் குறிப்பிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. மேலும், ஒட்டுமொத்த பரிவர்த்தனை அளவு $30 டிரில்லியனைத் தாண்டியுள்ளதாகவும், ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் விநியோகம் மற்றும் செயலில் உள்ள பயனர்களின் எண்ணிக்கை தொடர்ந்து அதிகரித்து வருவதாகவும் இந்த அறிக்கை தெரிவிக்கிறது.
